row:
Welcome to the home of The Female Rider Code — where strong riders are built from the inside out.
After 30+ years in the saddle and hands-on with performance horses across the globe, I realised something powerful:
Many horse issues aren’t just in the horse.They’re in the rider’s body, energy, and nervous system too.
This channel is for equestrian women who:
✅ Want to ride better — not harder
✅ Crave clarity in their body and their horse
✅ Are tired of second-guessing, feeling flat, or stuck in cycles of burnout
✅ Want to feel proud — in their seat, their strength, and their progress
Each week, you’ll find videos that bridge the gap between:
🐎 Horse behaviour & biomechanics (The AAA Method)
💪 Rider strength, recovery, and nutrition
Whether you came here for your horse or yourself…You belong in this new wave of horsewomen who lead with presence, not pressure.
Join the free global community here:
 https://www.skool.com/female-rider-code-7611/about?ref=79961952e7ad48ba9a37353591d3c77a
